Exact WAV/ALS bytes/hashes, level, rate, interval and accepted engine configuration must be retained before comparison. Enabled independently audible D has a known nonzero processed/wet output; separately established nonzero tail crosses source end where required. Establish A-to-G-to-Main, B-to-G-to-Main, nonzero R wet/output-to-Main and alternate C receiver individually before exclusions; correct Monitor/arm/clip state for any receiver. Record paste insert/selection and occupied regions; no clipboard codec, source-reference encoding or implicit collision behavior is supplied.
F-FREEZE: Future eligible nonempty ordinary clip track, actual available devices and known nonzero audio before Freeze; distinguish source files and generated Freeze samples, temporary tails and frozen status. Retain successful nonzero frozen playback before missing-device/media or post-edit comparisons. Session loop and longer unlinked envelope are independently known; no actual generated file is supplied.
F-FILES: Future writable isolated test Project P and Temporary Folder T with source/reference before-inventory. Successful write baseline required before denied/full/unavailable destination scenarios. Only test-owned assets are modified; storage failures are proposed, not executed. General Save/Collect/repair semantics remain project/media owned.
F-HARDWARE: Open prerequisite: actually accepted external audio/MIDI device and ports, driver/configuration, independently known active instrument or effect, nonzero gain/send and nonmuted wet return/output; separate direct/dry/hardware monitoring.
